name: x4y6mc-answer-watchdog
goal: Retire answers to ended runs without alerts and send each stale-live alert batch once while preserving delivery to live runs.

evidence: An open item can have a newly answered question and only an ended run; no live delivery or CoS alert is needed. A replay with new queue IDs must represent the same logical notification.

The finished-session case stopped after proving no retry. Extend it past a later answer and grace period. The CoS replay case used only explicit dependency messages; extend it with answer generations and refreshed queue IDs.

title: Review adjacent watchdog delivery and alert routes for the same lifecycle and duplicate receipt gaps.
